Attestation.description: Signed attestation by the project proponent.

signature.description: Signed attestation by the project proponent.

Attestation.title: Attestation

DateRange.description: A date range. Chronological ordering is not validated.
DateRange.title: DateRange

Evidence.description: A typed piece of evidence, inlined on the measurement or static value it backs.

collected_at.description: When the evidence was captured or produced.

hash.description: Optional integrity hash of the referenced evidence.

reference.description: A uri for a file, or an id or locator for a stream or record. Read according to kind.

Evidence.title: Evidence

EvidenceKind.description: The kind of evidence. Starter set; extend as needed.
EvidenceKind.title: EvidenceKind

InputKind.description: The kind of thing a ResultInput references.
InputKind.title: InputKind

Measurement.description: An observed value for a monitored parameter at a point in time. Was MonitoringResult in 0.1.0.

id.description: Stable identifier. Referenced by results as an input.

indicator_id.description: Which indicator within the plan this measures, where a plan has several.

plan.description: The monitoring plan this measures. References a MonitoringPlan by id.

source.description: Origin of this measurement (device, survey, record).

timestamp.description: When the measurement was taken. The reporting period it falls in is derivable from this.

value.description: The measured value and its unit.

Measurement.title: Measurement

link.description: Link to the methodology, where available.

MonitoringFrequency.description: How often an indicator is measured.
MonitoringFrequency.title: MonitoringFrequency

MonitoringPlan.description: The monitoring plan for one protocol requirement or carbon metric. Stands on its own so it can be referenced across project phases without being restated.

approach_to_monitor.description: The measuring and monitoring plan for this parameter.

calculation_method.description: Described method or procedure used to convert source data into the indicator or result. Computed results are modeled explicitly in Result.

equation_reference.description: Methodology equation(s) in which the indicator is used as an input or produced as an output.

expected_unit.description: The unit the indicator is expected to be reported in (UCUM where possible). Measured values carry the actual unit on their QuantityValue.

id.description: Stable plan identifier. Referenced by measurements and results.

indicator_id.description: IDs distinguishing indicators within one parameter (e.g. each pool, each risk category).

monitoring_frequency.description: How often the indicator is measured.

monitoring_parameter.description: The parameter being monitored, as the methodology's own parameter key or name. Not a closed CDOP list; sourced from the methodology.

overview_of_status.description: Description of the project's status and approach for this parameter.

purpose_of_data.description: Reason the indicator is required under the methodology.

qa_qc_procedures.description: Procedures used to confirm accuracy, completeness and integrity of the indicator.

required_threshold.description: Protocol threshold the indicator is measured against (e.g. '>=95%', 'N/A').

source_of_data.description: Origin of the data used for the indicator (on-site measurement, lab, records, methodology default, etc.).

supporting_evidence.description: Evidence supporting the plan (e.g. inventory report, management plan, certificate).

MonitoringPlan.title: MonitoringPlan

MonitoringScope.description: Monitoring plans, static values, measurements and results for a project.

calculation_worksheet.description: The Annual Monitoring Calculation Worksheet that accompanies the monitoring report.

chain_of_custody_and_application_evidenc.description: Documents tracing the monitored material from feedstock sourcing through production and final application.

hwp_worksheet.description: The Harvested Wood Products worksheet required by a forest protocol.

measurements.description: Observed values for a monitored parameter, each timestamped. Keyed; reference a plan.

methods_used_to_monitor.description: Protocol, tools, and methods used to monitor.

monitoring_plans.description: Monitoring plans, one per monitored parameter. Keyed; referenced by measurements and results.

requirement_categories_monitored.description: Standardized set of protocol requirement categories the project monitors.

results.description: Computed outputs. Each is produced from inputs that are static values, measurements, or other results.

static_values.description: Fixed inputs that are not measured each period: methodology constants and defaults, and ex-ante parameters including baseline. Keyed; referenced by results.

MonitoringScope.title: MonitoringScope

Project.description: A project with its reporting context, verification schedule and monitoring scope.

assessment_area.description: Eligibility context (Assessment Area / Supersection), if applicable.

attestation.description: Optional project attestation. When present, all required Attestation fields must be supplied.

methodology.description: The methodology governing the project, as identifier and version.

monitoring.description: Monitoring plans, static values, measurements and results for the project.

reporting.description: Reporting context: periods, preparer, completion date.

reporting_periods.description: The reporting periods for the project. Results reference one by id.

verification_schedule.description: Key dates in the verification process.

Project.title: Project

QuantityValue.description: A typed numeric value with its unit.

unit.description: The unit, as a UCUM code where possible, otherwise a methodology-declared unit.

QuantityValue.title: QuantityValue

ReportingContext.description: Reporting periods and report preparation details.

current_period.description: The reporting period this report covers. References a ReportingPeriod by id.

initial_period.description: The project's first reporting period. References a ReportingPeriod by id.

ReportingContext.title: ReportingContext

ReportingPeriod.description: A named reporting period. Referenced by results; a project can hold more than one.

date_range.description: Start and end dates of the monitoring window for the period.

label.description: Human label for the period, e.g. '2026 annual'.

vintage.description: The vintage period the outcomes for this period are attributed to. Distinct from the monitoring window.

ReportingPeriod.title: ReportingPeriod

Result.description: A computed output. Produced from inputs, where an input is a static value, a measurement, or another result. Chaining results expresses intermediate steps (e.g. baseline emissions, project emissions, leakage) up to a final value.

equation_reference.description: The methodology equation this result applies.

id.description: Stable identifier. May be referenced as an input by other results.

inputs.description: The inputs consumed to produce the output.

label.description: What this result is, e.g. 'baseline emissions' or 'net emission reductions'.

output.description: The computed value and its unit.

parameter.description: Optional methodology parameter key this result corresponds to.

period.description: The reporting period this result is for. References a ReportingPeriod by id.

Result.title: Result

ResultInput.description: One input to a Result: a reference to a static value, a measurement, or another result.

kind.description: Which kind of thing this input references.

ref.description: The id of the referenced StaticValue, Measurement, or Result.

variable.description: Optional role this input plays in the equation, e.g. the methodology symbol.

ResultInput.title: ResultInput

StaticValue.description: A fixed input that is not measured each period. Methodology constants and defaults, and ex-ante project parameters set at validation, including baseline. Carries source and validity.

id.description: Stable identifier. Referenced by results as an input.

kind.description: Whether this is a methodology default, an ex-ante parameter, or a baseline.

label.description: What this value is, e.g. 'net calorific value of fuel' or 'baseline fuel use'.

parameter.description: Optional methodology parameter key this value relates to.

source.description: Where the value comes from, e.g. a named methodology tool and version.

valid_from.description: Start of the validity period for this value, where applicable.

valid_to.description: End of the validity period for this value, where applicable.

value.description: The typed value and its unit.

StaticValue.title: StaticValue

VerificationSchedule.description: Dates of completed and planned verification.

last_verification_date.description: Completion date of the last verification.

next_verification_date.description: Date of the next planned verification.

VerificationSchedule.title: VerificationSchedule

description: A project with its reporting context, verification schedule and monitoring scope.

assessment_area.description: Eligibility context (Assessment Area / Supersection), if applicable.

attestation.description: Optional project attestation. When present, all required Attestation fields must be supplied.

methodology.description: The methodology governing the project, as identifier and version.

monitoring.description: Monitoring plans, static values, measurements and results for the project.

reporting.description: Reporting context: periods, preparer, completion date.

reporting_periods.description: The reporting periods for the project. Results reference one by id.

verification_schedule.description: Key dates in the verification process.
